title: drogna component heartbeat
description: The message every long-lived component publishes on ctl/heartbeat at its declared interval, and the only thing that lights a component in the client (FR-45, FR-52). The clock service publishes the first one, so this shape is settled here; feature 003 owns contracts/schemas/heartbeat.schema.json and must adopt it unchanged. Note what is absent: no host timestamp. Liveness is judged in simulation time, so a paused clock ages nothing and a rate change does not make a healthy component look dead.

sim_time.description: Simulation time of the heartbeat, ISO-8601 UTC with microsecond precision.

tick.description: The tick index the component had observed when it published. Present wherever the component holds a tick.

status.description: degraded and stalled are how a component says it is alive but not working, rather than going quiet and being read as dead.

run_id.description: The run this component is part of, matching the run manifest.

config_digest.description: SHA-256 of the configuration the component was started from. This is how a participant's digest reaches the run manifest: never the configuration itself.

detail.description: One line for a human. Never a substitute for status.
